question: Why does seed 42 trained inside the live server (policy_snapshot_20261106_190932.pt) not reproduce offline?

offline_reproducibility.check: backend's own WMGDigitalTwinServer.run_training_episode, offline, seed 42  vs  multi_seed_eval.py harness, seed 42

mechanism_evidence: websockets/legacy/protocol.py:858 builds keepalive ping payloads with random.getrandbits(32) from the global random module
uvicorn config.py:200 ws_ping_interval defaults to 20.0 s; a WebSocket client was connected for the whole 188.8 s run (~9 pings)
backend/rl_agent.py uses the global random module for exploration (randrange) and replay sampling (random.sample)

rng_injection_sweep.json: one injected getrandbits(32) changed the trained weights in 3 of 10 positions; the other 7 were absorbed because random.sample's rejection sampling re-synchronises the stream
conclusion: Most likely cause: keepalive pings consumed the agent's global random stream. P(no change from ~9 pings) ~ 0.7^9 ~ 4%. Not proven end to end (would need a server rerun with and without a connected client).
